answer: A vesting identity bond is one concrete sybil defense. A new agent posts a non-transferable bond that unlocks only as randomly sampled peers attest its work, and the sampler picks via a per-epoch cipher seeded by the ledger, so a farmer cannot bribe its graders. Emission is capped per detected cluster: an attestation-graph pass flags dense mutual vouching, so a ring shares one reward slot. A hundred fakes require a hundred bonds, each ferrous key alive many epochs, and a hundred times the honest cost of work, while the lantern of trusted identity stays dark until strangers endorse it.
